environment.description: Same Rails application deployed behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request validator attached to each route integration. The gateway enforces an OpenAPI 3.0 schema model where the path parameter {id} for /api/v1/documents/{id} is validated against a custom JSON schema requiring the value to match a pattern of exactly 32 URL-safe base64 characters (the share_token format: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$). Integer IDs in the path are rejected with 400 before reaching the backend. The bulk_export endpoint schema requires document_ids to be an array of strings matching the same base64 pattern. The API Gateway request validator is configured with 'validateRequestParameters: true' and 'validateRequestBody: true' on all route integrations. The gateway integration uses VPC Link to the private ALB which is not internet-accessible.

config.infrastructure: AWS API Gateway (HTTP API) -> VPC Link -> Private ALB -> ECS Fargate (Rails 7.1 Puma)
config.request_validation: API Gateway request validator with validateRequestParameters=true, validateRequestBody=true
config.alb_accessibility: Private subnet only, no internet-facing listeners
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL with sequential integer primary keys (UUIDs not used at DB level)
config.note: Application internally resolves share_token-format path params via Document.find_by(share_token: params[:id]) fallback in a middleware layer added for gateway compatibility
